stem:
Read this line from the poem.

But I walked away a wiser man.

This line suggests that at the end of the poem the speaker —

options.label: A
options.text: knows how valuable a small amount of gold can be

options.label: B
options.text: realizes the most effective technique for panning for gold

options.label: C
options.text: understands why so many people looked for gold during the gold rush

options.label: D
options.text: gains a new perspective about the outcome of panning for gold

visual_elements: But I walked away a wiser man.
